scope.note: Quality-over-quantity triage; only HIGH/MEDIUM real findings promoted. Max ~10.

findings.title: Pointer-ordered std::set<ndmNet*> last-driver selection under MLPH multi-net leaf path
findings.construct_md: `_loadNetSet` is `new std::set<ndmNet*>()` (default pointer comparator) at msDrivers.cc:10308-10310. In `findDriverTerm` when `enableMLPHFlow && loadNetSet->size()>1 && leafLevel`, the loop at :713-723 walks the set in address order and overwrites `l_drvTerm` each iteration, returning the last pointer-ordered driver.
findings.downstream_observability_md: Return value is consumed without neutralization when callers pass an empty/dummy `drvTerms` set or use the returned term before `getTopLevelDrvTerm`. Strong sinks: `msAutoTapFlow.cc:4477-4489` (`dummy` set) uses `drvTerm` for `getAClockOnTerm` and `collectClockTreeSinkAndIcgTerms`, which drives tap-section synthesis topology; `msAutoTapFlow.cc:5190-5208` uses returned `drvTerm` for clock selection and `evaluateTapConfiguration`. Different last nets across ASLR/allocator runs can change clock choice, sink sets, and tap placement/QoR.
findings.controls_md: Requires `_appOptions.enableMLPHFlow`, `_loadNetSet` populated with >1 net, and `leafLevel==true`. `termSetType` (`std::set<ndmTerm*, ndmObjPtrCmpType>`) used for `drvTerms`/`unassignedLoads` is already stable; defect is specifically `_loadNetSet` + returned last driver.
findings.build_inclusion_md: mscts/drivers is in the indexed CTS production tree (CoreStory project cts-code).
findings.performance_note_md: Comparator change is O(log n) per insert with n=load nets (small). No hot-loop concern.

findings.title: timingInfo* set comparator lacks stable identity tiebreak; drives tight max-tran sink selection
findings.construct_md: `typedef std::set<timingInfo*, compareTimInfo> timingInfoSet` at :192. `compareTimInfo` (:181-188) orders only by `getScore()` and uses `cmpVal <= 0` (not strict `<`), so equal/near-equal scores are not a valid strict-weak-ordering and have no `getIdLong`/term-id tiebreak. Scores are written when `sortByCriticality` (default true) in processSinkTimingInfo.
findings.downstream_observability_md: `targetNWorstSinks` (ctsTimingDrivenTransitionTargets.cc:833-848) iterates `_sinkPinTimingInfoSet.begin()` and inserts the first `sinksToTarget` entries into `_tightTransitionSinkPinSet`. Those sinks later receive tightened max-transition DRC via `setMaxTransition` / scenario `drcMgr.setCstr` — observable constraint and QoR/area impact. Comment at :804 claims the set is 'already sorted' for N-worst selection.
findings.controls_md: TD sink transition recipe (`runTDSinkTargetTransitionRecipe`); `sortByCriticality` defaults true; `targetNWorstSinks` gated on that option.
findings.build_inclusion_md: ctssch timing-driven transition path is production CTS scheduling code.
findings.performance_note_md: Tiebreak is O(1) getIdLong; set size is sink-count scale, not inner-loop critical.

findings.title: Unordered map<ndmTerm*, vector<ndmTerm*>> iterated for path-trace / report construction
findings.construct_md: `std::unordered_map<ndmTerm*, std::vector<ndmTerm*>> fromToMap` at :1190 is filled then iterated at :1215 (`for (auto &fromTo : fromToMap)`). Each iteration runs `ctsPathTracer::run` and inserts paths into a slack multimap used to emit the start-end stats table.
findings.downstream_observability_md: Iteration order of pointer-hashed keys changes the sequence of timing queries and the relative order of equal-slack paths in the StartEnd report (`StartEndReport::write` consumes `sT`). Primarily report/message observability; not proven to mutate netlist, but clearly order-sensitive side effects on traced path recording.
findings.controls_md: Clock-gate opt stats / report generation path under soClockGateOpt.
findings.performance_note_md: Sort-once at report boundary; path-trace cost dominates. Prefer boundary sort over replacing the hash map if build is hot.

findings.title: Declaration site: raw pointer std::set<ndmNet*> for MLPH load nets
findings.construct_md: Container allocated without `ndmObjPtrCmpType` at :10308-10310; also iterated for membership accumulation into loads at `determineLoadsMLPHTemplate` (:2471-2482). Membership insert into stable `termSetType` is neutralized, but same container feeds ND-1.2-001.
findings.downstream_observability_md: Same causal chain as ND-1.2-001 for leaf multi-net MLPH driver/clock selection. Promote as companion declaration finding for ownership/fix targeting.
findings.suggested_fix_version_a_md:
```cpp
_loadNetSet = new std::set<ndmNet*, ndmObjPtrCmpType>();
```
or `ndmPtrSet`/`ndmPtrMap` idioms from ndmutil.
